summary.intent: Resolve all open PR review comments on the phase-39 branch (user-configurable vault parameters) and plan the next phase of work.
summary.outcome: All 15+ review threads across 3 review rounds were triaged, fixed where valid, and resolved. PR #423 was merged to main. Phase 40 (desktop vault settings integration) was scoped and scaffolded as a new planning branch.

repo: cipher-box is a pnpm monorepo with packages: core, crypto, sdk-core, sdk, api-client, and apps: web, desktop, tee-worker
IPNS keypair derivation follows a pattern established in crates/crypto and packages/crypto — each domain gets its own HKDF info string (e.g. 'cipherbox-vault-settings-v1')
TEE enrollment pattern lives in StorageTab.tsx and must be replicated in any service that calls createAndPublishIpnsRecord
pnpm lockfile formatting churn (inline vs expanded YAML blocks) occurs when branches diverge in pnpm version or lockfile base — cosmetically noisy but functionally identical
The repo uses release-please for release automation on main
Phase planning docs live in .planning/phases/<N>-<slug>/ with CONTEXT, RESEARCH, VALIDATION, PLAN, and SUMMARY files
Commit 560c871fe on phase-38 branch removed a @cipherbox/core circular dep from vault-ipns.test.ts that wasn't yet merged into phase-39
Rust FUSE constants (MAX_VERSIONS_PER_FILE, VERSION_COOLDOWN_MS) are hardcoded in crates/fuse/src/constants.rs — not yet driven by vault settings

code.finding: validateVaultSettings originally used hardcoded literals (30, 10, 15, 'bin') that duplicated DEFAULT_VAULT_SETTINGS — refactored to reference the canonical constant
recycleBinRetentionDays min was 1; changed to 0 to allow disable/immediate-purge semantics per Phase 39 D-03 requirement
Unknown schema versions (schemaVersion !== 1) should return DEFAULT_VAULT_SETTINGS rather than silently coercing — prevents future v2 data loss
retentionDays field and setRetentionDays setter were write-only dead code after useBin.ts was updated to read from useVaultSettingsStore — removed entirely
Variable named prunedVersions actually held the retained entries (slice(0, maxVer)) — renamed to retainedVersions for clarity
setTimeout used without cleanup ref — fixed with useRef + clearTimeout in useEffect cleanup
Pre-existing @cipherbox/core import caused test resolution failure in phase-39 branch because the circular dep fix from phase-38 hadn't been merged yet

workflow: Resolve PR review comments workflow: fetch threads via GraphQL, triage against current code (not reviewer's description), implement fixes, run tests, commit, reply to threads, resolve via GraphQL mutation
Always verify reviewer findings against current code before acting — multiple rounds of comments were already addressed by prior commits
Stash uncommitted work before merging main to avoid conflict with staged changes
Background task race condition: foreground push and background task push can race — the second push fails harmlessly with 'already up to date'
pnpm lint:fix run after refactors produced no changes — ESLint was already satisfied
Security incident response: axios poisoned version published 2026-03-31; fix was pinning specifier from ^1.13.2 to 1.13.2 in pnpm-lock.yaml

friction: Lockfile had ~15k lines of YAML formatting churn after merging main — required investigation to confirm no functional changes
Background task race: foreground and background push commands raced, causing a spurious exit code 1 from the background task
vault-ipns.test.ts had a pre-existing circular dep import failure on this branch (fix was on phase-38 but not yet merged) — required manually porting the fix before new tests could run
CI caught a test regression (vault-settings.test.ts:54 still asserting old min=1 behavior) that local test runs would have caught if the test file had been in scope
Merge of main into phase-39 overwrote STATE.md with phase-38 state — required manual restoration of phase-39 progress
User interrupted a commit mid-flight to run pnpm lint:fix, requiring re-staging and re-committing
Three merge conflicts during main merge: ROADMAP.md (checkbox state), vault-ipns.test.ts (circular dep fix), useBin.ts (SDK refactor vs vault settings change)
open_items: Phase 40: Desktop vault settings integration — derive_vault_settings_ipns_keypair in Rust crypto crate, VaultSettings type in core crate, load/decrypt settings during complete_auth_setup, wire into FUSE constants to replace hardcoded MAX_VERSIONS_PER_FILE and VERSION_COOLDOWN_MS
VaultTab.tsx presets not implemented (thread 5 marked not applicable) — deliberate simplification, may be revisited
keypair.privateKey not cleared after use in vault-settings.service.ts — deferred as not applicable given session-lifetime key material, but noted as a potential hardening item
Desktop app (Tauri/Rust) has no access to versioning or bin UI but Rust SDK should still respect vault settings values for underlying operations
pnpm lockfile formatting inconsistency between branches (inline vs expanded YAML) — will resolve on next squash-merge to main
